Priya K.: Quick heads up — planning a 10-week remote stint in Costa Rica starting 2024-08-01 with my partner and toddler. Currently US homebase. Do I need to change homebase for this short period? How will the WFH stipend and monitor replacement be handled if I'm remote full-time for 10 weeks? Any customs/VAT issues for shipping laptop + dock? Also insurance for >30 days?

Nadia (People Ops): Thanks for the flag! Please submit the Location Change form and choose 'temporary abroad'. For stints under ~3 months we typically keep US homebase unless payroll/legal flags nexus. Stipend: we prorate for calendar days remote; payroll will confirm exact math.

Sam (Payroll): Payroll note: if homebase stays US, stipend remains USD and paid as usual, but we log the CR days for tax nexus. If homebase switches to CR, currency and withholding change. For 10 weeks we usually treat as transient and prorate by remote days in the pay period. If company pays duties/shipping, that amount could be a taxable benefit; reimbursements avoid that.

Ivy (Benefits): Health plan coverage is limited internationally. Over 30 days we often require a short-term international policy for medical coverage — DM me your dates and family details so we can advise. Dependents may need additional documentation.

Marco (Legal): Short legal note: Costa Rica doesn't generally create employer registration for isolated short stints, but repeated or long stints could. We'll review once the form is in. Provide travel dates and whether you'll be doing any contracting with local entities.

Customs Bot: Automated: Shipments to CR can attract VAT (~13%) and customs if not covered by temporary import procedures. If equipment stays >6 months, higher likelihood of assessment. Consider temporary carnet or local rental options.

Priya K.: Thanks. One add-on: I have a pending monitor replacement request. Can IT send it to my CR address, or should I arrange local purchase and expense?

Nadia (People Ops): Monitor shipping abroad is possible but often triggers customs. If it's under warranty IT may ship, but expect potential duties. Option B: approve local purchase + expense; we'll confirm policy for temporary stints.

Sam (Payroll): Action: once form is submitted, DM payroll your passport and shipping preference (company ship vs personal ship + expense). We'll calculate stipend proration and estimate any taxable benefit from shipping.

Priya K.: Submitted the Location Change form and attached tentative dates. DMing passports and family details now — appreciate the quick responses!
